banner._help: Home page banner above the hero. Shown as 'upcoming' while event.start_date is today or later, otherwise as 'waiting' (the next event isn't scheduled yet). Set enabled to false to hide it entirely. Only upcoming shows the RSVP button (and only if rsvp.enabled).

waiting.heading: We're planning the next one.
waiting.text: The last BarCamp is in the books. Date and venue for the next edition will land here soon — join the community channels below to hear first.

hero.heading: The unconference Bangalore builds together.
hero.sub: No fixed agenda. No keynote speakers. Just a room full of curious people and a blank schedule. Filled in by whoever shows up with something to say.

what.label: 01 — What's an unconference
what.heading: You decide what to talk about. You're in control.
what.body: There's no speaker list until the day itself. The schedule is built live! by you! and everyone else who walks in with a topic, a story, or a half-formed idea worth arguing about.
what.photo_caption:
PHOTO
attendees pitching a session on the board

who.label: 02 — Who shows up
who.heading: The most outside-the-box thinkers in the city. No, really.
who.body: Design, tech, creativity, entrepreneurship, astronomy, music — if it crosses boundaries, steps on toes, or just spreads joy, we want to hear about it.

moments.label: Moments from BCB
moments.heading: A few frames from years past.

cards.title: Talks
cards.text: Six rooms, six sessions running at once. Don't like one? Get up and walk into another. We call that the Law of Two Feet.

cards.title: Techlash
cards.text: Your six minutes of fame. Show the crowd something you built and inspire the room.

board.label: How the day takes shape
board.heading: The board fills in as the day goes.
board.body: No printed agenda! Just a whiteboard, a pack of sticky notes, and whoever grabs a marker first.
board.collapsed_text: ROOMS 01 · 02 · 03 — six sessions, a stack of posties, and a marker.
board.hint: ↑ this is what the board looked like at the last BCB. bring your own posties.
board._help: items[].type: 'slot' = a time row (cells: null = empty, string = sticky note, {"plain": "text"} = handwritten text). 'break' = full-width row, style is one of big | break | techlash | feedback.

cards.title: Introductory
cards.text: Introduce an idea, a tool, a lifestyle. Bridge the gap and start your cult.

cards.title: Open discussion
cards.text: Need feedback or opinions from the room? This format gets everyone talking.

cards.title: Deep dive
cards.text: Take an idea and dig in. Best suited for intermediate/expert-level talks.

rsvp_section.heading: Let us know you're coming.
rsvp_section.body: Your RSVP helps us plan an accurate headcount so the day runs smoothly for everyone.

venue.name: The Takshashila Institution (2nd floor) & Samagata Foundation (4th floor)

venue.directions: Take the metro and get down at the MG Road station on the Purple line. Walk over to Church Street Social to find the venue.

techlash._help:
The Techlash page: hero with the title, photo stack and a timer sticker, a facts strip, intro text, 'how to take part' steps, the session list, then a closing call to action. {year} is replaced with the event year, {home} with the site URL. intro[] items are paragraphs; , , ,
are allowed. photos[]: src, alt, caption; the first one is shown larger. steps[]: title, text.
techlash.label: Six minute brew
techlash.title: Techlash
techlash.lead: Show your tech or product to a diverse, enthusiastic audience. You get six minutes and the whole room.

facts.label: ideas go through a filtering process

photos.caption: Six minutes. Go.

intro: Are you an innovator looking to showcase your tech or product to a diverse and enthusiastic audience? Look no further than our Techlash Showdown at Barcamp! This session is all about giving participants the opportunity to present their latest and greatest tech or product innovations in a 6-minute time limit.

This session is open to anyone who has a product they would like to demonstrate. Whether you're an entrepreneur, inventor, or hobbyist, this is your chance to showcase your innovation to an engaged and supportive audience.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Register for Barcamp. There are a limited number of spots available, so sign up early to ensure your spot.

steps.title: Submit a session

steps.title: Keep your phone handy
steps.text: These ideas will undergo a filtering process. Put your phone number in the right field while adding your session, we might require some clarifications from you.

share._help: Used by the session pages. {event} {year} come from the event settings; {title} and {url} are the session's. The hashtag is event.hashtag; handle is appended as @handle.
share.label: Share this session

how_to_register._help: On the How to register page, every top-level list with 2+ items becomes a vertical step-by-step progress bar, unless the heading above it contains one of these words.
